title: On Time-Changed Birth-Death Processes with Catastrophes
summary: We study two time-changed variants of the birth-death process with catastrophe where the time-changing components are the first hitting times of the stable subordinator and the tempered stable subordinator. For both the processes, we derive the governing system of fractional differential equations for their state probabilities. The Laplace transforms of these state probabilities are obtained in terms of those of the corresponding time-changed birth-death processes without catastrophes.
